mappings.scope: download redirect behavior; retain registry metadata, digest, timeout and cleanup checks
private access-token self-update handoff, native common CLI handler and actual config-owner file protection; upstream release version excluded

fullTests.environment: CXV/CODEX/OTEL inherited flags cleared; isolated HOME/CODEX_HOME; actual workspace cwd

adaptations: Native CLI shares one handler across SDK, PTY and workspace modes.
Password sessions remain independent in-memory revision/generation records; URL-token inheritance does not preserve a password login.
Reuse existing atomicWriteFile with forced 0600 for handoffs; do not follow a stale target symlink.
Protect actual CODEX_HOME/cx-viewer handoff and atomic temp paths even when CXV_LOG_DIR points elsewhere.
CXV env namespace; no global Codex configuration changes.
firstFailures: E1 real 302 chain failed with unexpected redirect before changing redirect:error.
E2 isolated server produced a fresh random token before handoff consumption was implemented.
Actual config-owner search fixture exposed handoff paths before adding CODEX_HOME/cx-viewer to existing protection.
New CLI source contract initially counted only two launch modes; corrected to actual three shared registrations.
Running app tests from repository root with inherited SDK flags caused four pre-existing auth fixture failures; controlled package cwd passed 82/82.
First pack was rejected by the stale-dist guard; normal build then real pack regenerated baseline with exactly lib/access-token.js added.
The standalone runtime probe initially used one extra parent in its updateProgress import; it failed before spawning anything, then passed after the probe path was corrected.
limitations: No activity on user processes, active GUI or true global npm installation.
Remote password login must be repeated after process replacement; no password-session persistence added.
Windows, Electron GUI, WebKit and physical devices not verified in this package.
Runtime validation uses synthetic newer package versions only inside an owned temporary prefix.
observedFollowups: Large real tarball downloads emit existing WriteStream MaxListeners warnings from the unchanged drain/close Promise.race branch; both downloads, digest validation and cleanup succeeded. Not fixed by this scoped alignment.
